subject.title: fix(control-ui): increase chat history limit from 100 to 500

question: Should Control UI accept this PR's 500-message fixed initial history window as the closure path, or should older-history access require pagination/load-older behavior?
rationale: Both approaches address the linked issue, but the fixed-window patch increases every initial payload while pagination keeps startup bounded and needs a different implementation path.

options.title: Prefer pagination
options.body: Keep this PR paused or decline it once a viable load-older pagination path is ready, preserving a bounded initial payload.

options.title: Accept fixed window after repair
options.body: Let this PR proceed only after request-payload tests are updated and real WebChat proof shows the 500-message behavior works acceptably.

recommendation.title: Prefer pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this PR paused or decline it once a viable load-older pagination path is ready, preserving a bounded initial payload.
